acceptanceCriteria: `cem cite` refuses a plan whose row count or hunk digests do not match the prepared map, with a named refusal, and a test covers the 9-row plan against a 10-hunk map.
body: Filed on 2026-09-23 from the fresh-agent leg of V1-0146 (PR #102, extracted v0.7.0 build 46 archive, BASE d18db3d). Step 4: after a BUILD-LOG commit the map was re-prepared with 10 hunks and the stale 9-row plan was applied silently by ordinal, misattributing citations and leaving one unknown hunk.

completion.reason: Fixed by PR #134 (DCW-V0-019, decision 0376); script/dogfood-change_test.sh covers stale-nine-of-ten and stale-ten-of-nine. The reorder gap is filed separately (decision 0381 item 6). full-gate NOT_RUN.

title: cem cite: a stale citation plan is applied by ordinal after the map is re-prepared with a different hunk count
